basic_info.description: This stylish and modern Manhattan-style 2-story townhouse offers exceptional living in a spectacular setting. Google Spear St, Facebook, LinkedIn SF headquarter offices + the Transbay Terminal & SF Moma, ALL within a 6-10 minute walk. An exceptional family or investment residence for anyone interested in owning a piece of San Francisco real estate, strategically located in the heart of tech, arts & culture. One of only 4 homes with this floor plan, the unit's generous layout features 2 entrances and a balcony with gorgeous city views. Pet lovers can live with the amenities of a luxury high rise with the comfort & convenience of a front porch & the Embarcadero/Ferry Building for a perfect walk. Uncle Harrys Lounge access at The Harrison.
